# Droplet

Canonical: https://fuvji.github.io/droplet/
Source: https://github.com/fuvji/droplet
Version: 2.10.9
Platform: Windows 10/11 x64
Licence: proprietary, public source for inspection
Founder: @epufk

Droplet is a small, local keyboard-and-mouse macro suite for Minecraft Java,
branded Minecraft Zero Macro. It is a native Rust overlay with no runtime
dependencies, no network calls, no telemetry, and no game-memory access. It
injects ordinary keyboard and mouse input through Win32 SendInput and remains
visible to screen capture.

## Current release

- 2.10.9 portable executable: 545,280 bytes.
- Auto Crystal has a Return slot (`v5S3`, default `1`). A hold of at least
  160 ms restores it after release; a latched toggle restores it once when
  switched off. A short single press leaves the current hotbar slot alone.
  The restore is a double tap of the Return binding.
- `WM_DPICHANGED` updates scale, physical window size, rounded clip, hover,
  and hit testing together. Pointer coordinates stay physical, so hover and
  clicks do not shift a row or tab at 125% or 150%.
- Tests: 31 / 31. Four native 624×408 captures were regenerated from the
  2.10.9 build. No CPU, latency, or speedup claim is made.
- The 2.10.8 size pass used hidden `ShellExecuteW` instead of
  `std::process::Command` and bundled `rust-lld` + ICF.
- DWM supplies the antialiased 8 px corner when available; the GDI region is
  used only as a fallback, avoiding a hard second clip. The transparent
  quarter-rounds are click-through.
- Once a foreground game HWND is verified, the presence watcher reuses it until
  focus moves instead of re-resolving the same process image every 160 ms.
- The favicon and site header/footer use one transparent outlined droplet mark,
  with no tile, plate, border, background, or shadow.
- The focus-only gate is cached in an atomic updated on settings publish; the
  presence loop does not take the settings lock every 160 ms.
- Sprint settings are read only when a pulse is due, and crosshair settings
  only on a magenta hit. Poll cadence and bindings are unchanged.
- Sprint and crosshair enablement are cached too; those watchers skip the
  settings lock while inactive.
- The sprint watcher parks at 100 ms while inactive and is unparked immediately
  by focus or settings changes; its armed cadence remains 8 ms.
- No zero-latency or end-to-end latency claim is made.
- Download: https://fuvji.github.io/droplet/downloads/droplet.exe
- Checksums: https://fuvji.github.io/droplet/downloads/SHA256SUMS.txt
- Release ledger: https://fuvji.github.io/droplet/releases.html
- No MSIX, AppX, installer, or ZIP is published. The executable is direct.
- Linux and macOS are not supported yet. The hook, window, and paint layers are
  Win32-specific; no .deb, AppImage, tar.gz, dmg, zip, or img is published.
- 31 release tests pass.
- Game detection resolves the owning process: Java (`javaw.exe`/`java.exe` with
  a game signature) or Bedrock (`Minecraft.Windows.exe`). Browsers, Discord,
  editors, and the launcher are rejected, and two samples confirm presence.
- Compact 624x408 graphite acrylic overlay with an 8 px shared corner radius,
  no painted outer rim, and no top accent line.
- Borderless module cards with the original 28x16 sliding knob switch. No
  module glyphs and no ON/OFF text.
- Every trigger card switches between Hold (one-shot) and Toggle (latched repeat).
- Min/Max sliders are independent; editing one never rewrites the other.
- Anchor follows Hydrogen's A6 order and defaults to 47/53 ms, with Min
  47-97 ms and Max 53-103 ms. Air loop repeats while held.
- The tray icon was removed. A manual hide is sticky across focus changes.
  Ctrl + Right Shift shows or hides the panel.
- Dash, Shield, and Pearl select the slot and click in one SendInput batch.
- Pre-indexed trigger routing: 0.45 ns indexed versus 202.39 ns scanned (445x,
  routing only, not end-to-end latency).
- No streamproof or capture-concealment mode, no process hiding, no scan
  evasion, no anti-cheat bypass, no log erasure, and no zero-latency claim.
- No silent auto-updater. An update check would require a network path and a
  signed channel, which conflicts with the current no-network design.
- The site uses one local script for OS detection on the download page. It
  sends no data. There are no analytics, cookies, third-party scripts, external
  fonts, or ad clients.
